summary: This plugin adds a DeepSeek Harness web panel for viewing OBJ/STL/STEP models, lets users interact with them in 3D, and converts models into a standardized JSON format that can be inserted into chat context.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a web user interface utility that lets users load and inspect 3D models in DeepSeek Harness, then translate those models into a standardized, LLM-readable JSON format and pass it into chat context. Evidence in the repository description, README feature list, and DSH manifest shows both a host tool (`read_3d_model`) and a client overlay panel workflow, with supported formats explicitly including OBJ/STL/STEP and optional immediate send/export paths. The classification focuses on visualization and model handling rather than automation or external service orchestration.
